english.note: Use 理想 as the all-purpose everyday choice for a positive personal aspiration or goal, without an excessive or power-seeking shade.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an aspiration or dream, especially a personal life or career aim.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for an ideal or aspiration.

examples.english: My ambition is to open my own café.
examples.traditional: 我嘅理想係開間自己嘅咖啡店。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 hoi1 gaan1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3

examples.english: My aspiration when I was young was to become a doctor.
examples.traditional: 我細個嘅理想係做醫生。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 zou6 ji1 sang1

examples.english: My vision is to open a coffee shop.
